perks.name: Attrition Orbs

perks.name: Surrounded
perks.desc: This weapon gains bonus damage when three or more enemies are in close proximity.

perks.name: Golden Tricorn
perks.desc: Final blows with this weapon grant bonus damage. While this buff is active, grenade or melee kills of the same damage type greatly increase its damage and duration.

perks.name: Deconstruct
perks.desc:
Dealing sustained damage grants bonus damage against vehicles and constructs and refills ammo from reserves. Damage with Primary ammo or against constructs provides additional progress.

Constructs include barricades, turrets, Stasis crystals, and other objects created in the field.

perks.name: Golden Tricorn Enhanced
perks.desc: Final blows with this weapon grant bonus damage for an improved duration. While this buff is active, grenade or melee final blows of the same damage type greatly increase its damage for an improved duration.

perks.name: Wild Card
perks.desc: Final blows with this weapon have a chance to create experimental submunitions at the target's location.

notes: Inspired by @PodvsEnemies Podcast vs Enemies episode 934 (https://open.spotify.com/episode/0M24D3moUjRCXj0AtIsCCx?si=208c6d31bdb7453e) with @Saint_Kabr and @ImpetusAlways. First-choice PvE pick for add-clearing Minor spec enemies in general content. There aren't that many void auto-rifles obtainable in S23 and, while Ros Arago IV stats aren't great, there are still a couple of fun rolls worth looking out for. The Recoil Direction could probably do with some taming - Arrowhead Brake takes it to a much better looking 77. Otherwise, if you can control the shots, Smallbore adds a decent bump to range and stability as the barrel perk. In the magazine per slot, you could make an argument for Tactical Mag, Flared Magwell or Accurized Rounds to round out the stats a little further. Looking at Onslaught in the second trait column, the obvious pairings to keep the magazine topped off in the first column are Rewind Rounds or Subsistence. Finally, the submunitions generated by the Wild Card origin trait are great for helping soften up crowds. Recommended MW: Handling, Stability or Range, with a damage boosting (Minor or Taken Spec) mod.

pandapaxxy (PvE / Controller / M+KB): "Ros Arago IV is a great new option for those of us who don’t like or never got a good Gnawing Hunger. Ros Arago IV has a few tricks up its sleeve that even propel it over a good Gnawing Hunger like the addition of Golden Tricorn for damage; Rewind Rounds for slightly better magazine efficiency; Repulsor Brace for better subclass synergy; Onslaught for better DPS against higher health enemies. Depending on your needs, Ros Arago IV could even be your one and done void auto rifle." Recommended MW: Stability.

pandapaxxy (PvP / Controller): "Over in the crucible it is slightly better and slightly worse than Gnawing Hunger. Instead of getting bonus damage through Kill Clip you can decrease your time to kill via Onslaught. With arguably a better accuracy perk in Dynamic Sway Reduction over Zen Moment. It ultimately will depend on which model you prefer as well as which version you’d like. Both technically have time to kill reducing post-kill perks as well as accuracy boosting perks." Recommended MW: Range.
